data.heading: Sponges
data.text: Sponges are the simplest form of animals without a nervous system or muscles in their bodies.
Most species of sponges are found lying on the sea floor.
Sponges have thousands of pores in their body which let water flow through them continuously.
Sponges survive on the oxygen and nourishment from the water flowing through their pores and so are called filter feeders.
